title: CyberKit scope file
description: Optional .cyberkit/scope.json in the scan root. Narrows what a scan may touch with root-relative include/exclude globs. See docs/SCOPE.md.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

include.description: If non-empty, only paths matching one of these globs (or beneath a matching directory) are in scope.

exclude.description: Paths matching one of these globs, and everything beneath a matching directory, are out of scope.

pattern.description: Root-relative glob with '/' separators. '*' and '?' match within one path segment; '**' matches any number of segments. No leading '/', no '..' segments, no backslashes.
